jobs.title: Engineering Manager - Member Experience
jobs.description_text: Job Overview: We are hiring an Engineering Manager to run a squad that builds Omada's Member-facing systems. A squad owns problems from prototype to production, including the maintenance and the on-call rotation for what it ships. You own that squad: what it works on, in what order, and how the people in it grow. As an Engineering Manager, you ship code alongside your Builders. You own the execution and will run the squad’s rituals: iteration shaping, prioritization, backlog grooming, and estimation - these are your calls. Owning the call means having a point of view on the tradeoffs behind it, and partnering with your stakeholders to work through the problems that surface along the way. You partner closely with a Product Strategist who spends their time in front of members, coaches, and stakeholders, and who prototypes to test ideas quickly. They own what the squad should build and why. You own whether the squad can deliver it, at what cost, and by when. You set the quality bar and the operational standard for your squad and will be empowered by both tooling and adaptable processes to hold it. About you: You are comfortable being accountable for what your squad ships. You still write code, and you want to. This role ships production work every sprint, off the critical path, in the same codebase and the same agent workflows as your squad, so you feel the friction your people feel first-hand. You are a product engineering leader: you are opinionated about the product you own.

jobs.description_text: ***This is an onsite position in Centerville, OH*** POSITION SUMMARY A Sr Phlebotomist serves patients by identifying the best method for retrieving blood; preparing specimens for laboratory testing; and performing screening procedures. This team partners closely with Purchasing, Logistics, Manufacturing, Supplier Quality, and a global supplier network to protect production continuity and improve supplier delivery performance. What makes this team unique is its direct connection to daily production execution, long-term supply readiness, and cross-functional decision-making across more than 200 Tier 1 suppliers and thousands of parts and components. About the Role Lucid is seeking a Manager, Material Planning to lead the Material Planning team based at Lucid’s manufacturing facility in Phoenix, AZ. This role reports to a senior supply chain or materials leadership manager and exists to ensure production build requirements are supported through strong material availability, supplier execution, and MRP discipline. The Manager will close gaps in supplier performance, material readiness, inventory accuracy, and cross-functional escalation management as Lucid continues to scale production. In the first 12 months, this leader will own improvements in On-Time, In-Full performance, supplier delivery metrics, team operating standards, and communication routines that give the business clear visibility to material risk. jobs.title: Mobile Service Technician, Costa Mesa
jobs.description_text: The Mobile Service Technician is a unique position that covers field service repairs. This position would be responsible for traveling to client locations and will be responsible for diagnosing, maintaining and repairing Lucid Motors vehicles in the field. Lucid provides Mobile Service Technicians with a service van or truck and provides the needed tools. This fixed operation position will work independently as well as a team where you will have the support of the closet service location. You will demonstrate your passion for sustainable transportation and creatively solve problems in a fast-paced environment. As a Mobile Service Technician, it is expected to have ASE certifications obtained within 6-8 months of hire date. Lucid will reimburse the cost associated with successful completion. jobs.title: Order Operations Specialist
jobs.description_text: About the Team The European Order Operations team owns the end-to-end quote-to-cash transaction process and serves as the main operational partner for Retail and Corporate Sales teams on order-related matters. The team connects Sales, Delivery, Logistics, Service, Production Control, IT, Finance, Tax, and Accounting to maintain accurate orders and enable timely deliveries. It combines hands-on daily execution with structured performance management, issue resolution, and continuous improvement. The team’s impact is visible in orderbook accuracy, delivery readiness, revenue recognition support, and a reliable experience for internal and external stakeholders. About the Role The Order Operations Specialist is an individual contributor role reporting to the Supervisor, Order Operations and supporting the execution of Lucid’s European order-to-delivery operations. This role ensure s that customers and vehicle orders move accurately and efficiently through the transaction lifecycle, while providing Sales and Delivery teams with reliable operational support. Y ou will take ownership of day-to-day order execution, proactively resolve transactional issues, maintain accurate data across systems, identify opportunities for improvement, and ensure that vehicles, invoices, payments, and customer documentation are ready for delivery. Success will be demonstrated through accurate orderbook data, timely issue resolution, clear stakeholder communication, and improved operational consistency.
